claim.claim-text: 1. A surgical needle, comprising: an elongate member having a tissue-penetrating tip and a suture attachment portion, the elongate member having a base coating and a top coating, the base coating being formed from a base coating composition comprising a vinyl functionalized organopolysiloxane and a hydrofluoroether solvent, and the top coating being formed from a top coating composition comprising a polydimethylsiloxane and a hydrofluoroether solvent.
2. The surgical needle of claim 1, wherein the base and top coatings are spray-coated onto the elongate member.
3. The surgical needle of claim 1, where the elongate member further includes a primer coating formed from a coating mixture comprising a silicone resin and a solvent.
4. The surgical needle of claim 3, wherein the elongate member comprises a tungsten-rhenium alloy.

5. The surgical needle of claim 3, wherein the primer coating is disposed on and is at least partially covalently bonded with the elongate member, the base coating is disposed on the primer coating, and the top coating is disposed on the base coating.
6. The surgical needle of claim 14, wherein a combined thickness of the base and top coatings are less than about 8 microns.
7. The surgical needle of claim 1, wherein the base coating enhances the durability of the top coating.

8. The surgical needle of claim 1, wherein a force required to penetrate the tissue-penetrating end of the elongate body through tissue remains substantially constant when the tissue-penetrating end is passed through tissue at least about thirty times.
9. The surgical needle of claim 1, wherein the top coating comprises a hydroxyl terminated polydimethylsiloxane.
10. The surgical needle of claim 9 wherein the top coating further comprises a methyl-hydrogen siloxane.
11. A method for coating a surgical needle according to any preceding claim comprising
12. The method of claim 11, wherein the base and top coatings are spray-coated onto the elongate member.
13. The method of claims 11 or 12, wherein the elongate member comprises a tungsten-rhenium alloy.
14. The method of claims 11-13, wherein a combined thickness of the base and top coatings are less than about 8 microns.
